budget.sentence: The budget of this search is 120 genomes drawn for generation 0 and 24 individuals for each of the 5 generations after it, at most 80 fits dispatched; every legal point is fitted once and every refused point is counted and never fitted.

held_fixed.why: everything but the representation is the baseline_hand stage's own configuration; a hyper-parameter moved to make a point win would make the table unreadable

objective: the held-out mean absolute error in kW of the report the closure table reads, on the corpus sealed 33820b552ddf (sealing window 197, horizon 60); minimised

operators.mutation: per-gene uniform redraw within the declared bounds
operators.why: the operator set optimizer_plugins/default_optimizer.py already uses in this repository; a second genetic optimizer would be a second answer to a question that has one

differencing_order.why: 0..MAX_ORDER of the spec; an order above 0 under a transform that already differences is refused by the spec as AMBIGUOUS_DIFFERENCING

features.why: the seven meter columns of the sealed file; the subset a branch reads is the subset the graph gathers, and the empty subset is refused

excluded.1443: LAG_EXCEEDS_SEALING_WINDOW: the design candidate seasonal_lag_1443 was refused for this reason (sealing at 1443 leaves 8578 origins under seal a8c7f07f6d6c, not 9824 under 33820b552ddf)
excluded.2892: LAG_EXCEEDS_SEALING_WINDOW: the design candidate seasonal_lag_2892 was refused for this reason (sealing at 2892 leaves 7129 origins under seal 97155a063e25, not 9824 under 33820b552ddf)

lags.why: the design job's own motivated set -- the one-step lag, the autocorrelation peaks outside the white-noise band (74, 1443, 2892) and the decay lag (197) -- less the two peaks no point of this comparison could be scored under, which are excluded by the refusal that already removed the candidates naming them. A lag beyond the genome's own window is still refused

transform.why: the values m5phet.representation.v1 declares, and no others

window.why: the sealing window of this comparison is 197 rows: a stage whose window exceeds it cannot be scored on the sealed population at all, and that refusal is reused here as the bound of the space rather than worked around. The lower bound is the encoder's kernel size
